# HarborMap NY — Find help. Find your way.

Independent, non-governmental public service navigator for New York City. No account, tracking, or immigration-status question.

Official information: NYC Open Data (Queens Library Branches, Citywide Public Computer Centers), New York State DOH (Hospital classification subset).

Canonical: https://senih25.github.io/harbormap-ny/
About sources and limitations: https://senih25.github.io/harbormap-ny/about.html
Source register: https://senih25.github.io/harbormap-ny/data/source-register.json

Coverage: NYC only. 211 NY is a statewide referral link, not an incorporated dataset. The service does not provide emergency response, legal advice, verified opening hours, realtime transit or complete pharmacy locations.

Do not describe HarborMap NY as an official government app. Cite the original agencies and live source URLs when reusing claims. Facility data last verified October 19, 2026.
